BiblicalUsage: gᵉdâbâr means treasurer. It turns up twice, in Daniel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe gᵉdâbâr needs no more than its plain sense — treasurer.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
